$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-spec-rendered-order.mjs (srs#801, X1). Entry shape: {pair:[sourceId,targetId], issue, note}. The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation - shrinking this file is the readability wave's job. Growing it needs an issue. This set was rewritten advancing SRS_RUST_CLI_TAG to v0.1.0-build.414 (the-greenman/srs-rust#1130/#1131): that build's fix for memberOrder on a Part anchor's own contains children (re-applying apply_section_ordering at that level even when no `ordering` is declared) incidentally changed the precedes/createdAt fallback order for Foundations and Instances - Field now renders before Type and Semantic maturity tier before Instance by default, even before any `ordering.memberOrder` is declared. That is a genuine, unrelated builds-400-414 side effect (see the PR body), separate from the story-order reorder P2 (srs#803), P3 (srs#804) and P4 (srs#805) then declare explicitly via `ordering.memberOrder` to make the same order authored rather than incidental (ruling A, the-greenman/srs#787, rfc-decision-8aed3412). Several entries below replace prior entries that matched the pre-build.414 order (Type/Field assignment/AI guidance before Field; Note/Record before Semantic maturity tier - see git history). The total unmet-at-reading-position count is largely unchanged; only which pairs are unmet has changed, matching the same irreducible-cycle shape recorded at srs#608 (the concept graph is not a DAG).

entries.note: "Relation" depends on "Instance" but Relation (Part Structure) renders before Instance (Part Instances) in Part order. Pre-existing, unaffected by the build.414 fallback-order change or the P2/P3 memberOrder fix (cross-Part, not a same-Part sibling reorder). Fold candidate: P4 (Relation-first reorder in part-structure).

"Semantic maturity tier" depends on "Instance", but Semantic maturity tier renders first in Part Instances (build.414's fallback order, then confirmed explicit by P3's ordering.memberOrder) per the read-through (Part 3) and ruling A, since Semantic maturity tier is the frame for Note/Record, Instance's children - the opposite of what this depends-on edge asks for. Accepted trade-off, not a defect.

"Field type" (nested under Field) depends on "Vocabulary", but Field (and its Field type child) now renders before Vocabulary - Vocabulary was moved after Field per the read-through (Part 2: move Vocabulary after Field). Accepted trade-off.
"Graduation" (nested under Semantic maturity tier) depends on "Note", but Semantic maturity tier now renders before Instance (parent of Note) per ruling A. Accepted trade-off.
"Graduation" (nested under Semantic maturity tier) depends on "Record", but Semantic maturity tier now renders before Instance (parent of Record) per ruling A. Accepted trade-off.

"Composite value" (nested under Field) depends on "Type", but Field now renders before Type per the read-through's own recommended story order (Part 2: Field, Field type, Composite value, Field assignment, Type, Type specialisation) and ruling A. The read-through's own chosen order has this residual forward reference.

Composition (Part 6: Presentation) is read before Discovery (Part 7: Extensions) but depends on it. Discovery moved from Part 4: Structure to Part 7: Extensions under ruling R2 (the-greenman/srs#787) as part of unit P4; the edge is now forward as a direct consequence of that move. Same pair as spec-coherence-allowlist.json and spec-readability-allowlist.json entries for these ids. Fold candidate for a later Wave 5 unit.
